facts.statement: Ukraine and Russia concluded an agreement on the joint use and protection of border water bodies in Kyiv on 19 October 1992.
facts.source: Cabinet of Ministers of Ukraine, Resolution No. 1488 of 30 December 2022
facts.note: Checked 9 Nov 2026 on the Cabinet's page: the resolution ends the agreement “здійснену 19 жовтня 1992 р. у м. Києві” (concluded on 19 October 1992 in Kyiv).

facts.statement: Ukraine's Cabinet of Ministers decided on 30 December 2022 to terminate the 1992 agreement with Russia on the joint use and protection of border water bodies.
facts.source: Cabinet of Ministers of Ukraine, Resolution No. 1488 of 30 December 2022
facts.note: Checked 9 Nov 2026 on the Cabinet's page (Resolution No. 1488 of 30 December 2022, paragraph 1). The resolution states no date of entry into force; the Rada's legislation database records the agreement as ended from 4 January 2023.

facts.statement: The Kakhovka dam on the Dnipro was destroyed on 6 June 2023, flooding areas downstream.
facts.source: UN OCHA, Ukraine: Destruction of the Kakhovka dam, Flash update
